crossRefs.note: The soldiers led him away within the court, which is the Praetorium; and they called together the whole cohort.
They led Jesus therefore from Caiaphas into the Praetorium. It was early, and they themselves didn’t enter into the…
Pilate therefore entered again into the Praetorium, called Jesus, and said to him, “Are you the King of the Jews?”
When therefore Pilate heard this saying, he was more afraid.
He entered into the Praetorium again, and said to Jesus, “Where are you from?” But Jesus gave him no answer.
“I will hear you fully when your accusers also arrive.” He commanded that he be kept in Herod’s palace.
Judas then, having taken a detachment of soldiers and officers from the chief priests and the Pharisees, came there…

translations.web: Then the governor’s soldiers took Jesus into the Praetorium, and gathered the whole garrison together against him.
translations.bsb: Then the governor’s soldiers took Jesus into the Praetorium and gathered the whole company around Him.
translations.kjv: Then the soldiers of the governor took Jesus into the common hall, and gathered unto him the whole band
